The lighthouse, known as the Beacon of Eternum, had been a silent sentinel for centuries, guiding mariners through treacherous waters and stormy nights. Its towering presence was both a comfort and a mystery to the townsfolk, who had long since forgotten the tales of its origins.

The lighthouse keeper, an elderly man named Elias, lived in a modest cottage adjacent to the tower. Elias was a man of few words, his eyes holding the wisdom of the ages and a gentle sadness that hinted at a life lived in solitude.

One evening, as the sun dipped below the horizon, painting the sky with hues of orange and pink, a young woman named Marina arrived in Eternum. She was a traveler, driven by an insatiable curiosity and a deep love for the sea. Marina had heard whispers of the Beacon of Eternum and its enigmatic keeper, and she was drawn to the mystery like a moth to a flame.
